mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (indicating accommodative monetary policy) compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) indicates a robust housing market that stimulates consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses corporate profit margins and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances during a monetary tightening cycle when FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in rising INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.0% signals accelerating inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate revenue, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 1-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals broad-based economic strength that supports corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 60% of instances where both HOUST and GDPC1 are rising, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient.
